text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! I'm so sorry. To go and get 
injured like this...!
choice_data_list: Let's focus on treatment for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm totally fine! If I just sit 
around doing nothing, my body will get 
dull!
choice_data_list: しばらくは治療に専念しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's focus on treatment for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to stop. To beat my 
rivals... and to deliver a thrilling story 
to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I don't stand back up here, I'm no 
protagonist! So... please, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Now's not the time to push yourself too 
hard.

...All right. I'll rethink the training 
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: 今は無理をする時じゃない
……わかった。メニューを考え直すよ
choice_data_list_en: Now isn't the time to push yourself.
...All right. I'll rethink the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think it is admirable to stand by one's 
convictions. However, reckless actions can 
never be called effort.
choice_data_list: Because your future is what matters most.

Because your future matters more than 
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: 君の未来が、一番大切だから
貴方の未来が、一番大切だから
choice_data_list_en: Because your future matters most of all.
Because your future is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: ケガを乗り越えてから、また一緒に進もう
choice_data_list_en: Once we move past this injury, we'll forge ahead together again.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Maybe I was just rushing 
things a bit...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll heal my injury properly... and make a 
full comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! ...Trainer...! Yes, I will definitely 
see it through!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
K-Kh...! This kind of pain isn't enough to 
stop me...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: トレーニングはもう中止にしよう……！
choice_data_list_en: Let's call off the training for today...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: これ以上すれば、もっと悪化するぞ
これ以上すれば、もっと悪化するよ
choice_data_list_en: Push any further and it'll only get worse.
Push any further and it'll only get worse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's injury grew even more severe, and 
it would take quite some time to fully 
heal...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Yeah, this shouldn't be a problem at all!

Yeah, this looks like it won't be a 
problem!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right?! I'm getting plenty 
of good exercise!
choice_data_list: ああ、これなら問題なさそうだ！
うん、これなら問題なさそうだね！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that shouldn't be a problem at all!
Yeah, shouldn't be a problem at all with this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, keeping up this momentum...! 
I'll show you my glorious comeback!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, without letting her body get 
out of shape, Kiseki made a full recovery 
from her injury!
